description: Intent i025 (SNAPSHOT=s10, branch=timer-dwork-softirq-lock) complete. Two credible findings written to agent-state/findings/i025.json. FINDING 1 (medium): net/bridge/br_multicast.c:886-905 — br->multicast_lock (spin_lock_init at 1810) is shared between TIMER_SOFTIRQ callbacks taking plain spin_lock (br_multicast_group_expired:147 timer_setup:460, br_multicast_port_group_expired:205 timer_setup:491, br_multicast_router_expired:632, br_multicast_local_router_expired:660, br_multicast_querier_expired:674, br_multicast_port_query_expired:782, br_multicast_query_expired:1759) and process-context br_multicast_enable_port (lock 890, caller br_stp.c:458 br_port_state_selection from br_netlink.c:698/br_if.c/br.c) and br_multicast_disable_port (lock 901, caller br_stp_if.c:118 br_stp_disable_port from bridge stop/netlink dellink), both with plain spin_lock and no BH disable, while sibling process sites (853/1929/1946/2053/2090/2103/2142/2161) correctly use spin_lock_bh — proven mixed discipline and the exact timer-softirq analogue of the seed's missing spin_lock_bh. FINDING 2 (medium): drivers/scsi/libiscsi.c:1948 — plain spin_lock(&session->frwd_lock) in iscsi_eh_cmd_timed_out (scsi .eh_timed_out hook run from blk_mq_timeout_work, BH-enabled process context) versus TIMER_SOFTIRQ callbacks iscsi_check_transport_timeouts (lock 2088, timer_setup 2908) and iscsi_tmf_timedout (lock 1791, timer_setup 2932) on the same lock object; the same function was verified fixed with spin_lock_bh in sibling s02 and vulnerable in s05, confirming this s10 copy is the vulnerable variant. Both findings have literal source evidence, an untrusted trigger (attacker-influenced concurrency: multicast control traffic re-arming timers / iSCSI command timeouts plus per-conn transport timer), a violated missing-BH-disable invariant, and an unsafe use (timer softirq spinning forever against a preempted process-context holder -> soft-lockup/RCU-stall DoS). Candidates: 6 reported-sites (3 per finding), plus unresolved leads left for follow-up (iwlwifi pcie/tx.c txq->lock stuck-timer, cxgb4 sge.c ptp_lock, qdisc root_lock perturbation timers in sch_pie/sch_sfq/sch_red) and the ks7010 seed excluded per instructions. Limitations: static analysis only (no build/lockdep/PoC; tree lacks .config), enumeration halted by finalize directive with only the two sibling-confirmed timer-branch bug families deeply paired in s10.
